name: WSC
description: Beetle WonderSwan (mednafen_wswan) core to emulate Bandai WonderSwan / WonderSwan Color with NextUI on Anbernic H700 devices.
author: alecrem, dfbecker

changelog.v1.0.0: Initial release for the Trimui Brick (alecrem/Trimui-Brick-WSC). mednafen_wswan core (aarch64) from the libretro buildbot.
changelog.v1.1.0: Port to Anbernic H700 (h700 platform). launch.sh uses a POSIX log redirect so it works under dash on Anbernic's stock OS.
